Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

- Validating analog-mixed-signal microcontroller devices on manufactured hardware through investigating their electrical characteristics

- A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Information and Communication Technology (or comparable)

- Strong programming skills (e.g., C/C++, Python, MATLAB or similar) with a focus on test/automation in lab environments

- Strong experience with Git-based development, PR-based collaboration and CI/CD

- Nice to have: Exposure to automotive communication protocols and related transceivers; basic ability to support physical-layer and system debugging in the lab
- Fluent English skills required; German language skills are beneficial but not mandatory

jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Head CMC Drug Product - Parenterals (Senior Director) (all genders)

You strategically and operationally ensure the development, alignment, and execution of formulation and process strategies for parenteral drug products (small molecules and biologics), from early clinical development through in-market products / life-cycle management. In this role, you lead and develop a team in line with Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO) and collaborate closely across global development and Product Supply interfaces. If you want to shape innovative parenteral drug products, apply for our location in Wuppertal, Germany.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- You lead a team of ca. 25 scientist and technical staff located at Wuppertal, Berlin and Berkeley (USA) and  are accountable for the development, alignment, and implementation of formulation and process strategies for the parenteral drug portfolio (small molecules and biologics) across the product life cycle
- You enable your team to develop and assess high-quality, value-adding parenteral drug products for novel active ingredients and line extensions aligned with medical needs and marketing requirements
- As a member of the Drug Product Strategy and Leadership team you are allocating budget and resources, setting priorities, and providing line management for the department  in close alignment within CMC Drug Product
- You continuously develop the team based on the needs of global development teams and Product Supply product teams, following DSO principles
- You define the future functional strategy and evolve competencies, capabilities, and technologies while aligning strategies and priorities within Drug Product Development and with Product Supply
- Your team develops safe, robust, and economical processes for parenteral drug products, including process development, scale-up, validation, and transfer to internal and external manufacturing plants
You team supports pre-clinical and clinical DP manufacturing across internal and external facilities and drive cross-functional collaboration for late-stage clinical and commercial development
- You and your team ensure successful submissions and product launches through high-quality technical documentation, regulatory compliance, and strong internal and external interface management (including academia, supported by Scientific Leads)

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold an advanced degree (preferably PhD) in pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry, or a related field,
- You bring long-term experience (10 years+) in the pharmaceutical industry in drug product development and/or MSAT (preferred for parenteral dosage forms), covering both chemical molecules and biologics
- You demonstrate a proven track record of successful people leadership in drug product development and/or manufacturing
In-depth knowledge of regulatory requirements and quality standards (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA) sets you apart
- You stand out with strong project management skills, including capacity, timeline, and resource planning
- You have demonstrated ability to lead and develop global teams, drive organizational development, and enable continuous improvement
- Ensuring efficient resource allocation across sites, products, and projects
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, role-modelling, cross-functional collaboration, ability to work in matrix organisations and aligning strategies and priorities across functions define you
- Fluency in written and spoken English rounds off your profile; a good command of German is an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 129.700€ and  163.800€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. Ruhr-University Bochum (RUB) and its Faculty of Computer Science offer an excellent environment for aspiring young researchers. 20 years ago, the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security (HGI) was founded here. lt is now one of Europe's most prestigious institutions for basic computer security research. The HGI maintains extensive networks with leading research institutions worldwide and with media and industry. Moreover, it has produced numerous successful security startups. The pioneering work of the HGI forms the basis for the Cluster of Excellence CASA.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-11-09

- Our goal is to attract postdoctoral researchers and enable them to conducttheir research with the mentorship of a PI. We expect that within the durationof this contract, candidates will be able to achieve independent achievementsin research, e.g through publications or joint research endeavours.

- Fluent spoken and written English is also required.
- In addition, applicants should have basic knowledge of one or more of theresearch areas relevant to CASA: Cryptography, system security, hardwaresecurity, decentralized security, human-centered security, Al and security.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Brand Manager for Animal Health Global Brands (m/w/d) (Content-Marketing-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will support strategic marketing initiatives for individual brand(s), including long-term category strategy development for a portfolio to support success in strategic markets based on deep customer understanding.
- With a strong strategic focus, you will drive the Brand Plan and strategy deployment, including strategic pricing guidance, category focus, geo expansion, and clear prioritization.
- Working closely with the Franchise Head/Senior Brand Manager, you will support the development of marketing campaigns for brand(s) across veterinary and/or non-veterinary channels, resulting in channel-specific portfolio campaigns.
- In close collaboration with GCB, you will support the Franchise Head in governing brand strategy execution, including KPI definition and brand equity tracking in strategic countries.
- As part of the portfolio team, you will contribute to defining life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L initiatives.
- To enable successful execution, you will help define key strategic initiatives to achieve product targets, including must-win priorities.
- Additionally, you will drive digital transformation in marketing and promotion for brands and collaborate across the franchise and the wider pet business.
- Furthermore, you will support the development of brand guidance and brand positioning, ensuring that new and existing brands fit coherently into the portfolio and managing related changes (e.g. packaging, positioning, LCM).

Additional tasks for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Additionally, you will tailor brand strategies and strategic initiatives for (R)OPU archetypes, with a strong focus on strategic countries.
- Furthermore, you will define life cycle management for current brands and future projects, including review of pipeline and BD&L opportunities within the category.
- At the same time, you will lead the development of marketing campaigns across all relevant channels, with a strong emphasis on digital transformation.
- Beyond this, you will develop brand guidance and positioning, ensuring alignment of new and existing brands within the portfolio and steering changes such as packaging, positioning, and LCM.
- Finally, you will support the Franchise Head in overall franchise strategy development while being accountable for the brand/project budget and adherence.

Requirements

- University degree required; Master degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) highly desirable
- Highly specialized knowledge and work experience in different parts of business, including Marketing roles in local & regional roles. Sales role experience is desirable.
- Requires strong understanding of business operations across regional/local levels and different geographic specificities, portfolio specifics.
- Strong strategic marketing and analytical capabilities
- Fluent command of English

Additional requirements for Senior Brand Manager role:

- Long-term brand management experience; exposure to local and operational strategic marketing
- Proven project leadership and project management experience; budget and resource oversight
- Deep understanding of regional and local business operations, geographic specificities, and portfolio dynamics
- Strong stakeholder management skills; ability to influence and gain buy-in in a cross-cultural, matrixed environment
- Excellent strategic marketing mindset combined with strong analytical capabilities
- High agility; ability to evolve strategic and tactical approaches based on research data and industry trends

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - Quantum Mechanics and Modeling

As a key player in our R&D digital transformation, you will leverage quantum mechanics, physics-based modeling, machine learning and AI to predict molecular properties, design and prioritize compounds across our discovery portfolio. Collaborating closely with medicinal chemists, structural biologists, biologists, and data engineers, you will drive discovery project milestones and advance our digital transformation in R&D. Your role is crucial in shaping the future of drug discovery and development through innovative digital solutions.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- You advance drug discovery projects using quantum mechanics, data science, and modeling approaches to enable data‑driven decision‑making.
- You enable AI‑augmented Design‑Make‑Test‑Analyze cycles by advancing and applying methods for in‑silico compound design and characterization.
- 
Applying cutting‑edge quantum mechanics methods to advance drug development and to generate a deep understanding of molecular interactions is central to your function

- You collaborate closely with experimentalists and internal partners to identify scientific challenges and develop effective solutions.
- You lead strategic digital initiatives and actively co‑shape the R&D digital strategy.
- Working closely with the Data Science & AI unit to leverage next‑generation technologies and drive the adoption of digital solutions is a core part of your role
- You share your skills and knowledge by coaching and teaching others, demonstrating collaborative and supportive behaviors.
- You contribute to self‑directed teams that work collaboratively and align with Bayer’s leadership standards.

WHO YOU ARE

- You hold a PhD in quantum chemistry, computational chemistry, chemistry, computer science, or a related discipline, with strong knowledge of organic chemistry.
- Demonstrated success in an industry setting defines your professional track record, supported by extensive professional experience where you have utilized a diverse range of ligand‑ and structure‑based approaches, including virtual screening, docking, molecular dynamics, binding‑affinity calculations, generative design approaches, and holistic workflows
- You are proficient in quantum mechanics software such as ORCA and xTB, and you have experience in scripting, programming, and workflow automation
- You have experience working with AI‑driven DMTA loops in a pharmaceutical setting, as well as practical exposure to computational workflows that integrate AI, modeling, and chemistry
- You demonstrate high interest in managing high‑performance infrastructure and working with external IT providers
- You emb  holistic health principles and align your work with the organization’s vision as part of Bayer.
- Curiosity, creativity, and a strong passion for drug discovery are central characteristics that define you
- Fluency in English (written and spoken), with strong communication skills and the ability to present complex data clearly and effectively, round off your profile

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This position can be filled on a full-time or near full-time (min. 80%) basis.

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Whether it’s hybrid work models or part-time arrangements: Whenever it is possible, you will have the flexibility to work how, when and where it is best for you.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.
- We promote health awareness and opportunities for selfcare through various measures, such as free health checks with the company doctor.
- We emb  diversity by providing an inclusive work environment in which you are welcomed, supported, and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Be You. Be Bayer.

Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

Join our WLP FO expert development team within the Core Acquiring Tribe at Worldline, where you'll serve as a recognized domain expert for a specific area of the Worldline Pay Front Office authorization and switching systems. Working alongside fellow WLP FO experts and in close collaboration with the WLP FO Architects, this senior role combines deep technical C++ expertise with extensive business knowledge in financial authorization — requiring you to act as the go-to authority within your domain, a best-practices resource for the team, and a trusted bridge between business requirements and technical implementation.

Day-to-day responsibilities

- Serve as the recognized expert within your specific WLP FO domain — guiding teams and stakeholders through complex technical and business challenges, and acting as the primary point of reference for your area of expertise internally and externally
- Collaborate closely with the WLP FO Architects and fellow domain experts to ensure architectural coherence, standards alignment, and consistency of technical decisions across the broader WLP FO platform
- Lead and own the development of C++ software solutions within your domain for real-time electronic payment processing and authorization, championing best practices and technical quality
- Interpret complex business requirements within your domain and translate them into innovative, scalable technical solutions — proactively identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities, and escalating cross-domain implications to the WLP FO Architects where appropriate
- Define and own technical solutions and requirements for new WLP FO functionality within your scope, recommending best practices and driving alignment across product management, software architecture, and key stakeholders
- Champion the conceptual and technical integrity of payment authorization features within your domain, leading technical reviews and contributing to quality standards across the wider expert team
- Guide and formally mentor junior and mid-level team members on complex technical and business challenges within your domain, serving as the best-practices and quality resource
- Lead functional teams or projects within your WLP FO domain, coordinating cross-functional efforts and ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives in collaboration with the WLP FO Architects

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what's next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:

- Recognized expertise in a specific WLP FO domain within payment authorization systems, with extensive experience in IT services and software development, advanced C++ programming skills, and deep knowledge of relational databases/SQL
- Proven ability to work collaboratively with architects and fellow domain experts,  contributing deep domain knowledge while maintaining awareness of cross-domain dependencies and architectural standards
- Proven ability to guide others through complex technical challenges within your domain — serving as a best-practices authority and quality resource within and beyond the team
- Strong business analysis capabilities with a track record of interpreting complex stakeholder requirements and translating them into innovative, scalable technical solutions
- Demonstrated experience leading functional teams or projects in Agile environments, managing cross-functional stakeholder expectations in complex international settings
- Excellent analytical, conceptual, and communication skills, with the ability to interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend solutions with broad organizational impact
- Deep expertise in the electronic payments sector, specifically in acquiring or issuing authorization systems, is strongly preferred
- Excellent English skills
